note: Makhachev explains why Topuria lost to Gaethje (lost focus, pre-fight party) and says he will be back. Source: Makhachev is only loosely linked to a fight with him (a superfight that fell through, occasional words), so other_fighter rather than opponent_side.

Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight and names two options (Gaethje rematch, Pimblett); the outlet guesses early 2027. Fact could be health instead, since the article also states he has recovered from the orbital fractures; that recovery line is why reports_his_health is yes, but it is close to 'only says when he will be ready'.

Retired fighter Matt Brown says an immediate Gaethje rematch could ruin Topuria and he should fight someone like Moicano first. Next fight: the article relays Jon Anik's claim of internal UFC conversations about a rematch as background; an editor could count that as talks.

Interview with Topuria's physio about his work, technology and FISIOEXPO; Topuria is the hook and gets a few answers (tolerates treatments, curious about his health, recovers with rest and machines). Centrality: much of the piece is general physiotherapy, so only_mentioned is arguable. Act: the physio describes his training and recovery habits rather than any news, so none_of_these or assesses_him could fit.
Fight report: Donchenko beat Soriano by unanimous decision in Paris, now 4-0 in the UFC. The embedded tweet is the UFC's, not his.

The saved text is one sub-headline (Topuria addressed his loss in a letter to his son) plus comment-policy furniture. Labelled on that one line; a stub this thin could be judged differently, and the letter to his son could be read as personal_life.

Topuria's first post since the loss: a video letter to his son Hugo about losing and getting back up, quoted at length. Fact: taken as personal_life (family, a life lesson); an editor could call it no_fact since it is talk, which would make firmness none. The Pimblett and Nurmagomedov matchups are the writer's speculation.

Pimblett, long linked to a fight with Topuria, says he would love to fight him but nobody has spoken to him about it; the rest is the outlet's analysis of Topuria's options. Fact and next fight: Pimblett's 'no negotiations' line and the recalled January attempt are close to next-fight news, but the article carries only wishes and speculation.

Donchenko interview: his TUF final win, asking Dana White to sign his friend instead of paying him, and his purse (20-50k dollars). Fact: money is listed under personal_life, but the purse and the request are a year old, so no_fact is arguable. Next fight: the Sept 5 bout vs Soriano is stated only as a closing note.

Donchenko says Ukrainians are ready to fight Russians but the UFC avoids such bouts to dodge hate, citing the cancelled Poteria fight. Next fight: the Sept 5 bout vs Soriano in Paris is stated in a closing background line, not as the news.

Live results page for the whole UFC Paris card; Donchenko's bout gets a full round-by-round and the official result. Centrality: a results page usually means only_mentioned, but he gets a real paragraph of content here.

Dana White on the Jim Rome Show: nothing scheduled yet, but Topuria is ready to fight; Gaethje rematch or Pimblett both fine. Fact could be health since the news is that he has recovered from the double orbital fracture; health yes rests on that recovery line, which is close to 'only when he will be ready'. His own social post and Malki Kawa's wish are paraphrased, not quoted.

MMA Junkie analyst picks Soriano to upset Donchenko by KO in round 2; preview covers both men. Next fight: the bout is booked and reported as happening Saturday, though it is a preview rather than booking news.

Morning Report on Makhachev ranking welterweight contenders; Amosov gets two lines where Makhachev calls him not dangerous. Centrality: a short paragraph in a long roundup, though a bit more than a name in a list.

DraftKings betting picks for UFC Paris; Donchenko gets one paragraph (backed to finish Soriano) among three fights. Next fight: the Sept 5 bout vs Soriano is stated as a booked fight, but as a preview, not booking news.

Heavyweight Josh Hokit posts that neither Topuria nor Pereira deserves a title shot next; attention split between the two. Next fight: Jon Anik's 'internal conversations' about a rematch are quoted as background, which an editor might count as talks.

Belal Muhammad says Topuria does not deserve an immediate Gaethje rematch and should fight Pimblett. Next fight: the article also relays Dana White saying Topuria is ready to return with two options, as background to the opinion.
